Issue: Tokens in localStorage (7-day refresh token readable by JS)
Risk (in simple words): Any XSS or malicious browser extension can steal a long-lived session
Suggested Fix: httpOnly cookie for refresh token, memory for access token

Issue: Production API reached over plain HTTP IP via Netlify proxy
Risk (in simple words): Passwords and tokens can be read or changed in transit

Issue: Every company admin created from the UI gets the shared DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD (form has no password field)
How It Was Found/Tested: Code review company-create-form.tsx + BE test auth.default-password
Risk (in simple words): Anyone who knows the default can log into new workspaces

Issue: Open redirect blocked (//evil and /\evil); prefix trick /w/acme-evil passes the check
Risk (in simple words): Low: guard bounces wrong workspace; no external redirect found

Issue: Text from API (company names, test names) is escaped by React; no dangerouslySetInnerHTML found in app pages
How It Was Found/Tested: e2e fe.companies.xss, sim.fe.malicious; grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML [FE-TC-030]
Suggested Fix: Keep; sanitise CKEditor HTML before saving and before rendering previews

Issue: CKEditor 'Source' button lets admins enter raw HTML that is saved as-is
Risk (in simple words): Stored script can reach the candidate app
Suggested Fix: Disable Source mode or sanitise on save (backend)

Issue: No idle timeout or refresh; forced logout every 15 min; logout clears storage
Risk (in simple words): Users reuse shared lab computers; failed refresh pushes them to keep tabs open

Issue: Frontend host sends no CSP / X-Frame-Options (static hosting config has none)
Mock credentials and OTP compiled into the bundle
Risk (in simple words): Confusing but not usable against real API
